milestones.title: Prove the foundations
milestones.outcome: Reset parity and fail-closed runner are fixed. Prove Fernlands on phones, measure the 11-redo/19-first-package workload and settle initial operations/device decisions.

milestones.title: Connect all five

milestones.title: Finish the world
milestones.outcome: All 40 residents: required movement/actions/reveals, five habitats and expansion stages accepted. Freeze new features and content.
milestones.gate: Nov 8: both platforms pass the five-island walkthrough. Cut optional features first; any roster/date change needs Frozair.

milestones.title: Play it for a week
milestones.outcome: Seven days of signed beta observations, device checks and recovery evidence.
milestones.gate: Fresh/returning players, both OSes, offline/retry/recovery and supported-device endurance pass.

milestones.title: Submit, then stabilise
milestones.outcome: Public submissions Nov 16. Resolve store feedback and release defects.
milestones.gate: Public Apple + Google review, not just TestFlight/Play Internal. Approval timing is external.

milestones.title: Open the sanctuary
milestones.outcome: Five accepted islands. Approved public builds. Recovery and monitoring ready.
milestones.gate: Launch only when gates are green. Never trade save safety or a complete island for the date.

work.title: Prove Fernlands on phones
work.status: Source parity fixed · native proof open
work.why: The reset defect and compile-failure runner are fixed. Remaining acceptance requires an authorized native candidate and both platform coverage.
work.doneWhen: Fresh arrival → shop → hatch → work → collect/sell → expand → travel, then OS kill/relaunch with intact ownership, eggs, Bag, collection and events. Fernlands by Oct 25; all five by Nov 1. Record exact build/device/backend scope.

work.title: Benchmark 11 redos + 19 first packages
work.why: 10 approved looks integrated; 11 redos and 19 first packages remain. Iguanodon reveal source integration passed, but its partly polished ranch work and pending full-package/native acceptance do not reduce the 30 remaining.
work.doneWhen: At Oct 25 compare measured complete-package rates separately for redos and new bodies. Oct 23 minimum: 30 packages / 16 days × 7 = 13.1/week, including 19 first packages at 8.3/week, before polish/worlds/QA. These are requirements, not observed capacity. Present resources/date tradeoffs if capacity misses.

work.title: Complete the 40-species data contract
work.why: Seed-last source proof covers all40 homes/eight-shop/Book/starters. Remaining exact economic and asset contracts must match the approved game.

work.title: See what alpha players do

work.title: Resolve later-island profile choices
work.status: Selected packages approved · later profiles open

work.title: Finish the five island casts + worlds
work.why: Locked40/approved stills and seeded homes are complete. Asset production still includes11redos+19first packages; worlds/expansions, voice coverage, habitat and native QA also remain.

work.title: Prove phone performance + recovery
work.why: Older debug captures cannot certify the final release build.

work.title: Sky after the first five

decisions.title: The 40 and their homes are locked
decisions.recommendation: Frozair approved the complete five-island roster. Iguanodon and Brachio are in Fernlands; the revised Snow eight are fixed. Casting is complete; final art and native acceptance remain.

decisions.title: Approve later-island profile choices
decisions.recommendation: Selected economy packages and the all-island hatch curve are source committed. Latest bounded study matches all 40 actual prices; its inputs exclude the newer hatch curve. Review 24 Giants/Snow/Swamp assignments with coherent earning/Luck/XP/abilities. Keep prices and Brachio 2B unchanged; retain the once-daily 5–6-week target.

decisions.title: Paid launch or free launch?
decisions.recommendation: Choose one small, proven purchase loop only if it fits. Otherwise launch free and schedule monetisation next. Full pass/catalog is a proposed deferral.

decisions.title: Which phones do we promise?
decisions.recommendation: Agree minimum Android/iPhone devices and budgets by Oct25. Scoped Android release evidence does not qualify the five final islands or replace physical iOS coverage.

decisions.title: Does the measured pace fit Nov 8?
decisions.recommendation: Forecast11redos+19first packages separately, plus remaining Forest polish, worlds and native QA. If capacity misses Nov8, remove optional features first and present resources/date tradeoffs. Never silently cut the40.

decisions.title: Agree next creature production scope
decisions.recommendation: Iguanodon dedicated reveal is integrated locally and passed source review. Coordinate with its art owner to finish partly polished ranch work, full-package/Frozair review and full hatch UI/native proof. Record complete-package timing; bound Titanoboa/Mammoth experiments within agreed method and spending.

risks.title: 30 asset packages before Nov 8
risks.action: 10 approved looks integrated; 11 redos + 19 first packages remain. The 16 days to Nov 8 require 13.1 packages/week minimum, including 8.3 first packages/week, before polish/worlds/voices/QA. Source reveal progress is not a completed package. No sustained capacity demonstrated; decide resources/date tradeoffs Oct 25.

risks.title: Unproven body types and wetland behavior
risks.action: Prove Mammoth weight, Titanoboa continuous motion and aquatic residents’ water access early. Validate 16 residents, duplicate mixes and service clearance; still concepts are insufficient.

risks.title: Native five-island proof is still missing
risks.action: Seed-last source parity is verified. Fernlands native full loop/kill-relaunch byOct25 and allfive byNov1 still need exact-candidate evidence, including physical iOS. Internal alpha delivery is separate from final five-island acceptance.

risks.title: Final profiles and pace remain unqualified
risks.action: Latest bounded study matches all 40 actual prices; older frozen commercial capsules retain 15 substitutions. The study excludes the newer approved hatch curve. Review 24 later-island assignments with coherent earning/Luck/XP/abilities; qualify Brooder/Amber, spending/events/variants and ordinary/unlucky play before player forecasts.

risks.title: Public review is external
risks.action: Start setup now; submit Nov 16 and protect the final fortnight for fixes.

risks.title: Recovery is not yet proven
risks.action: Recheck dated backup/monitoring gaps now. Initial proof Oct 25, hosted isolated restore and staging load Nov 1; final regression Nov 15.

launchGates.label: Five meaningful islands
launchGates.proof: Eight accepted species per island, 40 total. Each island: unlock, arrival, shop, hatch/reveal, work, collect/sell, every expansion, Book and offline return.

launchGates.label: Understandable progression
launchGates.proof: Fresh-player and ordinary-return observations; credible normal-dino gate route, no ultra-rare requirement. Exact values approved.

launchGates.label: Stable release phones
launchGates.proof: Both OSes, minimum supported devices, repeated travel/hatch/shop, 16 residents/duplicate variants, endurance and retry cases pass agreed limits.

launchGates.label: Saves + operations
launchGates.proof: Update/reinstall/account-link recovery, hosted backup and isolated restore, crash receipt, load/rollback evidence. No known critical data or duplication faults.

launchGates.label: Both stores approved
launchGates.proof: Public approvals for the exact candidates; listings, disclosures, audience/deletion path and any paid receipt/odds flows complete.

launchGates.label: Director acceptance
launchGates.proof: Frozair approves island readability, motion, reveal delight and collection identity from final native play.

deferred.title: Water / Lagoon
deferred.reason: Water is inactive WIP in the new launch source configuration. Frozair approved a fresh-start pre-release reset policy, but this maintenance task executes no hosted reset or rollout.

deferred.title: Sky, Riverbend and extra islands
deferred.reason: Sky is Frozair’s preferred future candidate. Finish and stabilise five first.

deferred.title: Full season pass + broad premium catalog
deferred.reason: Proposed cut pending Oct 25 revenue decision. One validated paid loop is the maximum recommendation.

deferred.title: New hybrids, decor and art rewrites
deferred.reason: Proposed postlaunch work unless needed to fix a demonstrated launch-blocking defect.

changes.text: Iguanodon dedicated reveal integrated locally and passed source checks/visual review; complete-package/Frozair/full UI/native acceptance remains open. Stegouros polish accepted in source. Counts stay 10 integrated / 11 redos / 19 first packages; 16 days to freeze require 13.1 total and 8.3 first packages per week, not observed capacity.

Latest bounded #56 study matches all 40 actual prices; older 15-substitution capsules remain historical. New approved all-island shop-band hatch curve and per-island daily personal starts are source committed. The study excludes the new hatch curve; final profiles, model/gameplay proof and native gates remain open.

Recommended Oct22–25 recovery sprint: finish/time Iguanodon, prove Fernlands on phones and make a measured capacity/resource decision Sunday. Conditional Anky redo sample; optional polish/new features parked as recommendations. Fresh-start/fixture proof is separate from real unlock pacing.

Reset parity and fail-closed runner fixed. Workload corrected:10approved looks integrated,11redos+19first packages remain. Approved economy/storage/Fernlands packages implemented;15source/model prices still differ. Oct25 phone and capacity gates remain open.
Historical Oct20 checkpoint: reset-order defect was found and Forest refresh advanced. Later verified repair supersedes that blocker; subsequent decisions approved selected numerical packages.

All 40 now seeded in approved source homes, eight per shop/Book, with five active islands and recorded local loop proof. Native/hosted launch rollout and final balance remain open; 19 still use placeholder art. Selected still baseline approved, Rex reveal committed. Fresh-start decision retires legacy relocation work.

Frozair locked all 40 species and island homes. Casting review closed. Fresh source audit: 21 committed ranch banks, 19 missing; 14/40 obtainable anywhere, 10/40 in intended homes. Para/Kentro are committed; Dilophosaurus has banks. Fernlands phone slice and production benchmark lead the updated plan.

Recommended habitat revision: Iguanodon → greener Fernlands; Nanuqsaurus, Prince Creek Edmontosaurus, Leaellynasaura and Woolly Rhinoceros proposed for Snow. Borealopelta, Cryolophosaurus, Citipati and Concavenator benched in this proposal. Eight per island/40 total and all milestone dates stay; no game data changes.
